stage0022_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$オズマ$$
「That man calling himself $$ニーバ$$...
　did he call himself a $$ＰＳ$$ on his own?」

stage0022_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Even with his combat power enhanced,
　a man who kidnaps a woman for his own desires
　is the lowest, most disgusting scum there is.」

stage0022_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Let's do this, $$キリコ$$.
　We're bringing $$フィアナ$$ back, no matter what!」

stage0022_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$オズマ$$
「No need to thank me.
　She's a comrade in arms to me too.」

stage0022_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$オズマ$$
（I understand, $$キリコ$$.
　I can tell the rage boiling inside you...）

stage0022_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$オズマ$$
（Your Assault Love Heart... let's see it.）

stage0022_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$アルト$$
「That man calling himself $$ニーバ$$...
　did he kidnap $$フィアナ$$ just to fight you?」

stage0022_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$アルト$$
「How dare he!
　What does he think a life's worth!」

stage0022_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$アルト$$
「I'll back you up.
　$$キリコ$$, make that guy regret
　ever doing something so stupid.」

stage0022_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$アルト$$
（What an idiot...
　Sure, he'll get his wish to fight $$キリコ$$,
　but it's like walking in to die.）

stage0022_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$アルト$$
（Even I, who've known him a good while,
　find $$キリコ$$ scary right now.）

stage0022_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Don't worry, $$キリコ$$.
　They're not stupid either.
　They won't hurt the hostage.」

stage0022_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「You picked me as your partner,
　so you want backup, right?」

stage0022_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Leave it to me.
　My sniping will back up
　your rescue mission perfectly.」

stage0022_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Units are closing on this area.
　Likely ATs... two units total.」

stage0022_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ルカ$$
「I prepared data from our past $$ＰＳ$$ battle.
　It should be useful too
　when you fight that man, $$ニーバ$$.」

stage0022_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Ha... I'm glad to hear
　words like that from you, $$キリコ$$.」

stage0022_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ルカ$$
「But I understand how you feel too, $$キリコ$$.」

stage0022_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Well... just between us,
　there's someone I like too...
　and for that person, I'd also...」

stage0022_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$カナリア$$
（Looks like words aren't needed.
　He's more focused than usual.）

stage0022_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$カナリア$$
（$$キリコ$$ has no openings.
　All I need to do is support him.）

stage0022_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$クラン$$
「That man calling himself $$ニーバ$$...!
　Taking a woman hostage, what a disgrace to warriors!」

stage0022_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$クラン$$
「A guy like that calling himself Perfect is a joke!
　I'll make him taste defeat and save $$フィアナ$$ for sure!」

stage0022_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$クラン$$
「No need to thank me.
　...Though I am a little envious of $$フィアナ$$.」

stage0022_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$クラン$$
「I'm a woman too, you know.
　To be cared for so deeply by a man like you,
　she's a lucky one.」

stage0022_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$マオ$$
「That man, $$ニーバ$$...
　he knew that you're
　the $$レッドショルダー$$, huh...」

stage0022_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$マオ$$
「He's the type to hold a hostage
　over some twisted grudge. Don't let it bother you.」

stage0022_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$マオ$$
（He's plenty fired up...
　Enough to scare me, standing next to him.）

stage0022_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Checking the wind's direction and strength.」

stage0022_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Now I'm all set.
　No matter who I face, I won't miss.」

stage0022_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Ha... quit it!
　Hearing words like that from you
　makes my skin crawl.」

stage0022_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$クルツ$$
「But hey, since you picked me,
　for $$フィアナ$$'s sake, let's do this.」

stage0022_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$宗介$$
「Can you win without knowing the enemy's strength?」

stage0022_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$宗介$$
「So that's not the issue here.
　That's not like you.」

stage0022_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$宗介$$
「I sortied because it was my mission.」

stage0022_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$キリコ$$
「No.
　I mean the fight in the Hanka Autonomous Region.」

stage0022_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$宗介$$
（Back then, I fought to save Chidori...
　without caring about odds or efficiency...）

stage0022_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$宗介$$
（Was that because it was a mission...?
　Or was it something else inside me...）

stage0022_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「...Most likely, $$カン・ユー$$
　is with that $$ニーバ$$.」

stage0022_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「Word is, he's quite the big name
　in $$ア・コバ$$'s $$バトリング$$」

stage0022_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「Careful, $$キリコ$$.
　That man, $$ニーバ$$... he's after you personally」

stage0022_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Someone with a grudge against $$レッドショルダー$$...」

stage0022_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$n
「$$キリコ$$...
　Why did you pick me as your partner?」

stage0022_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$n
「Wasn't I the one not suited
　to fighting?」

stage0022_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$キリコ$$
「You're trying to fight even while lying to yourself」

stage0022_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$キリコ$$
「...That makes you the same as me」

stage0022_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$スズネ$$
（Is $n lying to his own heart...?
　Could this be what Captain $$ジェフリー$$
　was trying to talk to me about...）

stage0022_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$キリコ$$
（That man, $$ニーバ$$...
　he holds a grudge against $$レッドショルダー$$...）

stage0022_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Well, you didn't run, $$キリコ$$!
　I'll give you credit for that!」

stage0022_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Worried about the woman?
　Don't worry.
　She's at our base」

stage0022_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Though, there's no chance
　you'll leave this battlefield alive!」

stage0022_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Here I come, $$キリコ$$!
　I'll make this your grave!」

stage0022_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「What's the meaning of this!
　Are you trying to get in my way!?」

stage0022_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「Fall back, $$ニーバ$$.
　We'll handle the rest from here」

stage0022_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Is this your doing, $$ボーソン$$!?」

stage0022_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「Our objective is your completion
　as a $$ＰＳ$$, and $$キリコ・キュービィー$$'s elimination」

stage0022_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Silence!
　Don't butt into my fight needlessly!」

stage0022_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Given this turn of events, we'll swiftly
　wipe out the enemy and strike the mastermind」

stage0022_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, begin your attack.
　Show these underhanded cowards our strength」

stage0022_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Damn it!
　Fine then, I'll just kill him myself!」

stage0022_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ミーナ#120$$
「But then, what about the hostage, $$フィアナ$$...?」

stage0022_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ボビー$$
「Don't worry, $$ミーナ#120$$.
　The $$ボス$$ has that all figured out」

stage0022_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Sergeant $$ラム$$, open a comm line」

stage0022_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
Jeffrey
「To everyone listening on this channel.
　I am the captain of the Macross Quarter,
　$$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$」

stage0022_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We will never yield to those
　who resort to the cowardice of hostage-taking」

stage0022_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「If any harm comes to her,
　we will hunt you down with everything we have!
　With everything we have!」

stage0022_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「If you mean to fight us,
　then challenge us head-on!
　We will take you on! That's all!」

stage0022_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ボビー$$
「With a threat like that,
　they won't try anything foolish now」

stage0022_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Ground forces under Major $$カリーニン$$
　are already watching the $$ア・コバ$$ area」

stage0022_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$キャシー$$
「If there's any movement,
　a report should come in immediately」

stage0022_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Fools, the lot of them.
　Taking a hostage only fueled our anger」

stage0022_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All that's left for them
　is to scrape together what forces remain
　and challenge us to one last battle」

stage0022_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Tch!
　Something got in my way today!」

stage0022_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Remember this, $$レッドショルダー$$!
　Next time, I'll kill you!」

stage0022_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Tch!
　Something got in my way today!」

stage0022_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Remember this, $$レッドショルダー$$!
　Next time, I'll kill you!」

stage0022_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Until then, keep trembling
　while you think about the woman!」

stage0022_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「No good!
　My unit won't hold much longer!」

stage0022_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「You useless wretch!
　Get out of my sight!」

stage0022_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「If you get in the way of my fight,
　I'll kill you first!」

stage0022_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「U-understood!
　$$カン・ユー$$ will withdraw at once!」

stage0022_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Now the dead weight is gone.
　Come on, $$レッドショルダー$$!」

stage0022_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「I've been waiting, $$レッドショルダー$$!
　For the day I'd finally get to kill you!」

stage0022_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「That hell in the Omuro wastes...!
　The hell you put us through, I never once
　forgot, not to this very day!」

stage0022_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「To vent that rage and hatred,
　I volunteered myself for $$ＰＳ$$ conversion!」

stage0022_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Even with half my body turned to machine,
　I have no regrets if it means killing you!」

stage0022_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$キリコ$$
（So this man still drags his hell with him too...）

stage0022_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Don't get in my way, Quentian!」

stage0022_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「This man... he said $$ＰＳ$$, but he's
　unlike $$フィアナ$$...! A far more vile thing!」

stage0022_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Don't lump me with those Gilgamesh
　wrecks! A more evolved $$ＰＳ$$, that's me!」

stage0022_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$n
「You want to fight $$キリコ$$ that badly!?
　Enough to take a hostage!?」

stage0022_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「What's wrong with that!?
　My fight belongs to me alone!」

stage0022_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$n
「You...!
　Regret what you did, in hell!」

stage0022_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$スズネ$$
（Whenever someone's life is put at risk,
　$n shows fierce anger...）

stage0022_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$スズネ$$
（Is that $n's true reason to fight...?）
